name: flavorpress-content-analyzer
description: Experimental local-first editorial content analysis toolkit for FlavorPress.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flavorpress/analyzer-core build && pnpm --filter @flavorpress/cli build && pnpm --filter @flavorpress/desktop build && pnpm plugin:build
scripts.test:wordpress-bundle:fresh: pnpm --filter @flavorpress/analyzer-core build && node --test --test-name-pattern "WordPress committed bundle matches the current source build" tests/wordpress-bundle.test.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm scan:names && pnpm test:wordpress-bundle:fresh && pnpm build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm scan:names && pnpm build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=packages/analyzer-core/dist/**/*.js --test-coverage-lines=85 --test-coverage-branches=75 --test-coverage-functions=85 --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:quality: pnpm test:coverage && pnpm check:security && pnpm benchmark:analysis && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
